shortDescription: Manage Alerting Policies points in Grafana

options.name: Continue
options.description: Continue matching subsequent sibling nodes if set to C(true).

options.name: grafana_api_key
options.description: Grafana API Key used to authenticate with Grafana.

options.name: groupByStr
options.description: List of string. Group alerts when you receive a notification based on labels. If empty it will be inherited from the parent policy.

options.name: groupInterval
options.description: Sets the wait time to send a batch of new alerts for that group after the first notification was sent. Inherited from the parent policy if empty.

options.name: groupWait
options.description: Sets the wait time until the initial notification is sent for a new group created by an incoming alert. Inherited from the parent policy if empty.

options.name: muteTimeIntervals
options.description: List of string. Sets the mute timing for the notfification policy.

options.name: objectMatchers
options.description: Matchers is a slice of Matchers that is sortable, implements Stringer, and provides a Matches method to match a LabelSet.

options.name: repeatInterval
options.description: Sets the waiting time to resend an alert after they have successfully been sent.

options.name: rootPolicyReceiver
options.description: Sets the name of the contact point to be set as the default receiver.

options.name: routes
options.description: List of objects Sets the Route that contains definitions of how to handle alerts.
